title: PQC Readiness Observability Gaps in Networked Computing Environments
description: Source repository for the IETF Internet-Draft draft-vicente-pquip-pqc-readiness-gaps. Documents gaps in operational visibility for post-quantum cryptographic readiness in networked computing environments. IETF PQUIP Working Group. Author: Brian Vicente, Sanctum SecOps LLC.
